The methods behind the OPDI data are described in two places:

- **Release v2.0.0**: the [Methods](methods/index.qmd) section has one page
  per method, each with how it is computed, what it was compared with, how
  accurate it is and its limits. [Processing steps](methods/pipeline.qmd)
  shows the whole chain, and the
  [Validation summary](methods/validation-summary.qmd) gives the accuracy of
  every item on one page.
- **Release v0.0.2**: the methods of release v0.0.2 are described on
  [Release v0.0.2](data/v0.0.2.qmd#how-release-v0.0.2-was-computed).

## Flight list {#flight-list}

Release v2.0.0: [Track identity](methods/track-identity.qmd) and
[Departure and destination airports](methods/airports.qmd).
Release v0.0.2: [flights and departure and destination airports](data/v0.0.2.qmd#flights-and-their-identifiers).

## Flight events {#flight-events}

Release v2.0.0: the event pages listed in [Methods](methods/index.qmd#the-methods-pages).
Release v0.0.2: [flight events](data/v0.0.2.qmd#flight-events).
